name: Really? Really!
source:
The story takes place on a holiday after Rin got together with Kaede.

Primula comes back to the Fuyou home as a family.
The King of Gods and King of the Devils examine Primula's emotional control in front of Rin and Kaede. However, right in the middle, Primula's magical force - which far exceeded their expectations - goes out of control and affects Kaede's mind.

The various memories within Kaede are rearranged in tatters.
As a result, Fuyou Kaede is left in a state of utter confusion and falls asleep. 
Nobody knows when or if she will awaken.

Rin infiltrates Kaede's mental world with his friends and tries to correct the scattered memories to save her.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=100]MangaGamer[/url]]

Really? Really! is the third installment of the Shuffle! series. It is a continuation of Kaede's path from the first Shuffle! visual novel.

The player must use keywords acquired from viewing various events in Kaede's memories to fix the memories. 

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Really?_Really!]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在枫和凛在一起后的某个假期。普莉茉拉作为家人回到了芙蓉家。神王和魔王在凛和枫面前考察普莉茉拉的情感控制能力。然而，就在过程中，普莉茉拉远超他们预期的魔力失控了，影响了枫的心智。

枫脑海中的各种记忆被打散得支离破碎。结果，芙蓉枫陷入了彻底的混乱状态并昏睡过去。没有人知道她何时会醒来，或者是否还能醒来。

凛和朋友们潜入枫的精神世界，试图修正散落的记忆来拯救她。

[引自[url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=100]MangaGamer[/url]]

《Really? Really!》是《Shuffle!》系列的第三部作品。它是第一部《Shuffle!》视觉小说中枫路线的延续。

玩家必须利用从枫的记忆中观看各种事件获得的关键词来修复记忆。

[编辑自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Really?_Really!]Wikipedia[/url]]
